rewrites.title: Smartphone HUD Head-Up Display
rewrites.descriptionHtml:
Keep your eyes on the road with the DriveKit Smartphone HUD Head-Up Display, a windshield projector that mirrors your phone's navigation and speed data directly onto your line of sight. This clever device reflects your phone screen onto a transparent display panel, giving you turn-by-turn directions and speed information without ever looking down at your dashboard or phone mount.

Simply place your phone on the HUD base, launch your favorite navigation app, and the projector creates a clear, floating display that appears to hover above your hood. The adjustable brightness and angle ensure perfect visibility in any lighting condition — from bright daylight to dark nighttime driving. Anti-glare coating on the reflector eliminates distracting reflections.

Compatible with all navigation apps that support HUD mode, including Google Maps, Waze, and Apple Maps, this head-up display reduces distraction and improves driving safety. The non-slip base keeps your phone secure during acceleration and braking, while the compact design doesn't obstruct your view of the road ahead.

  • Display: Projects phone screen onto transparent reflector
  • Compatibility: All HUD-capable navigation apps
  • Brightness: Adjustable for day and night driving
  • Anti-glare: Coated reflector eliminates reflections
  • Mounting: Non-slip base, secure phone hold
  • Angle: Adjustable projector angle for perfect view
  • Safety: Eyes-up driving for reduced distraction
